name: @shres-code/shres-code-claude-credential
description: Claude subscription-credential engine for the Shres Code: reads the credential the Claude Code CLI's sign-in stored (macOS login keychain service Claude Code-credentials, ~/.claude/.credentials.json elsewhere), serves the OAuth access token while valid, refreshes through console.anthropic.com's refresh_token grant, and persists rotations back for the CLI, as one shared Cordis service (ctx.claudeCredential)
